verdicts.evidence: isFile guard disconnected; a narrow-footprint hole (verdict denial, not a false green), stated as such. On the realistic neighbour — a DIRECTORY named ADR-0001-x.md — both forms coincide, measured: readFileSync(EISDIR) → catch → false; direct function call identical (false/false) and real CLI identical on the directory fixture (exit 1/1, identical outputs). The divergence lives on the FIFO: mkfifo runward/adr/ADR-0005-fifo.md in an otherwise green mission → shipped `check` exit 1 in ~1 s (isFile false → the entry is discarded WITHOUT open); mutated: readFileSync OPENS the FIFO with no writer → open(2) blocks indefinitely — measured: no verdict, no output, process killed by our 30 s timeout. The gate freezes on an input any operator can construct. A nuance stated honestly: the shipped build ALREADY freezes on the same fixture under `check --strict` (unratifiedAdrs reads every .md without an isFile guard) — the mutant extends this freeze to the plain check, it does not invent the class of defect. Sockets: open fails → catch → false on both sides. Nothing sees it: no leg places a non-file in adr/ (evidence-nonregular.test.js targets evidence pointers, not the journal); full replay of the net on the mutant green.

(Identifying the occurrence: the three `return false;` of isRealAdr are name guard, isFile guard, catch; the name-guard mutant is killed by the unit test "an adr/ holding only ordinary markdown is untouched" and cannot have survived CI; the order of the list — this mutant between the isFile guard and the floor line — places it on the isFile guard, consistent with its survival.) Measured: direct function call, directory ADR-0001-dir.md: shipped false, mutated true. Real CLI, green mission whose adr/ = template + an EMPTY DIRECTORY named ADR-0001-decision.md: shipped `check` exit 1 "○ Decision journal — raw template"; mutated exit 0 "✓ Decision journal" — a mkdir clears the decision journal. Nothing sees it: no fixture of the net puts a non-file in adr/; full replay of the net on the mutant green (unit/smoke/oscal/intoto/sarif/spelling/audit exit 0, self-gate exit 0 identical).

verdicts.evidence: Equivalent, argued with a sensitivity control and measured. The emptied catch makes the function fall off the end of its body: it returns undefined instead of false, on the only paths that throw (EACCES, ENOENT race, dangling symlink — statSync/readFileSync identical in both forms, so the same triggering paths). But the FIVE call sites of isRealAdr in the build coerce the return value to a boolean: mission.js:132 and :195 and status.js:60 (.filter predicates), mission.js:175 (.filter(...).length), compliance.js:92 (`if (!isRealAdr(f, dir) || …) continue`) — undefined is indistinguishable from false there. Sensitivity control: the neighbouring divergent input would require a consumer that tells false from undefined (=== false, serialising the raw return value into an artifact, indexing by the value) — none exists, the value never leaves a boolean context, and the export is typed boolean on the TS source side. Measured: direct function call on an EACCES file (chmod 000): shipped false, mutated undefined, the filter keeps 0 entries on both sides; real CLI on the mission with the unreadable file: exit 1/1, outputs identical line by line. Full replay of the net on the mutant green, consistent.

verdicts.evidence: The inverted catch: fail-OPEN on the unreadable. When the read throws, the shipped build answers "not a decision" (fail-closed); the mutant answers "decision". Recipe: green mission whose adr/ = template + ADR-0002-locked.md (real body, **Status**: accepted, then chmod 000 — broken permissions happen in real repositories). Measured by direct function call: shipped false, mutated true (EACCES → catch). Real CLI: shipped `check` exit 1 "○ Decision journal — raw template"; mutated exit 0 "✓ Decision journal" — a file NOBODY can read, whose content the gate can verify NEITHER for content NOR for the 40-char floor, is counted as a decision and opens the Architect phase. Nothing sees it: no leg places an unreadable file in adr/ (the spelling corpus chmods evidence POINTER fixtures, not the journal); full replay of the net on the mutant green (unit/smoke/oscal/intoto/sarif/spelling/audit exit 0, self-gate exit 0 identical — with CI running as a non-root user, the recipe would be just as effective there).
